english: 7-9. Bṛhaspati and Indra were walking on gleefully. On their way they saw this wonderful person of huge size. He was quiet and composed and very refulgent with matted hair on his head. Without realising that the person who stood there blocking their path was Śiva himself, Indra who was proud of his authority said to him.
